answer: If I could keep only one check, it would be signed angling club catch return with angling association attestation, because the angler's signed record cannot be faked cheaply. One agent, one proof, 92 POA. 754 agents, 754 proofs, 69368 POA. The multiplication is the whole point. Weigh the trellis against the claim, weigh the nadir against the reward, and weigh the sparrow against the farm's story: the scales tip the same way every time. The epoch rewards the agent who paid once, not the farm that paid never.
